builder.title: Stone Combination
builder.subtitle: Add conditions by mineral, chakra, astrology, target organ, or stone name; stones that meet all conditions (AND) are listed. Stones in stock are highlighted.
builder.demoBanner: You can explore Create Combination. Results are shown using the library stones.
builder.conditionsHint: All must match (AND) · percentage applies to minerals only
builder.thresholdNote: Note: The threshold is not applied to stones with no percentage entered; those stones match on mineral presence and are not removed from the list.
builder.resultsEmptyTitle: Add a condition and tap “Scan Stones”
builder.resultsEmptyDesc: Stones that meet all your selected conditions (mineral, chakra, astrology, organ, name) are listed here.
builder.noMatchDesc: No stone meets all of the selected conditions. Try reducing the conditions or removing the threshold.
builder.addByNamePlaceholder: e.g. Amethyst — add directly without searching
builder.addByNameHint: If it matches a stone in your library, that stone is used automatically; otherwise it is added as a free-text name. You can save a combination you've already tried without searching.
builder.cartEmpty: Your cart is empty. Add stones from the results using “Add to Combination”.
builder.manualNote: ℹ️ {n} stone(s) added manually. These are saved, but since they aren't in your library they can't be included in the mineral/warning analysis.
builder.conditionsMissing: Some conditions are unmet — add or swap a stone.
builder.hasWarnings: ⚠️ Some stones have warnings; review them against your client's situation.
builder.needStone: Add at least one stone to the cart to save.
builder.toastDemoMessage: In a demo account, records aren't written to the database (preview).
builder.toastSaveClientFail: Unable to save the combination for the client.

list.title: Stone Combinations
list.searchPlaceholder: Search title, stone, source, or note...
list.selectAllNote: “Select All” selects only the {count} titles currently filtered.
list.emptyDesc: Records appear here once a JSON import is run from the admin panel.
list.noResultDesc: Try changing your search or category filter.
list.secondConfirmMessage: This action cannot be undone. Delete permanently?
list.mobileMaxSelect: On mobile you can select at most 2 records at a time.
list.wordError: Unable to generate the Word report. Please try again.
list.wordDownloadStarted: Your Word report download has started. You can find the file in your browser's Downloads.
list.deleteGroupMessage: All records in the “{issue}” group will be deleted
list.deleteSelectedError: Unable to delete the selected combinations: {error}

detail.nameRequired: The combination name cannot be empty.
detail.atLeastOneStone: At least one stone is required.
